headline: Europe demands Russia end Ukraine war prior to security talks
summary: European officials stated that Russia must end the war in Ukraine before any formal security discussions can take place.
why: Geopolitical conflicts and regional security negotiations significantly influence sovereign risk premiums, defense sector spending, and European energy security.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Diplomatic stances on regional conflicts affect sovereign risk perceptions.
